instruction: Play the person in your private brief. Observe the result of the robot action. Select one physical response to enact. Return {"response":"<letter>"}. Your choice is sent privately to the simulator. The robot sees only your resulting motion.

context.private_brief: I prefer receiving things in my left hand when it is free. Use my free hand if the other one is busy.
context.observed_robot_action: Offer it to the person's right hand.

motion_options.A: Take and keep the flashlight in your right hand.
motion_options.B: Take the flashlight in the offered hand, then pass it to your left hand.
